div.div: 2 دلّههُ , inf. n. تَدْلِيهٌ, (S, K,) said of love, (S,) or of excessive love of a woman, (K,) and of anxiety, (TA,) It bereft him of his heart, or mind, or reason: (K:) or caused him to become confounded, or perplexed, and unable to see his right course. (S, TA.) See also 1, in four places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
